story_type: boater in the water hauled in on a heaving line and dragged over the rail of a rescue boat
hook: Their boat flipped a mile out, in November.
narration: Their boat flipped a mile off the Jersey Shore, in November, and this man was in the water.
The seventeen foot boat had capsized off Point Pleasant with four men aboard.
All four had life jackets on, and one had a handheld marine radio.
A waterproof marine radio can call the Coast Guard on channel sixteen when a phone is soaked or out of range.
A crew from Station Manasquan Inlet threw him a heaving line and pulled him in.
Then they grabbed him by the life jacket and hauled him over the rail.
outcome: The Station Manasquan Inlet crew rescued all four men from the capsized boat.
title: Boat flipped a mile out in November
description:
On Nov. 6, 2010, a Coast Guard Station Manasquan Inlet boat crew pulled four men from the water after their 17-foot boat capsized one nautical mile off Point Pleasant, New Jersey.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/99751/capsized-vessel
